content:
alice: Heads-up: scheduling a v2 cutover for /generate tonight 23:00 UTC. 2h change window. Can people confirm known client pins, odd client behavior, or blockers? deploy-bot will start canary at 22:45 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job `v2-cutover-/generate` -> 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary at 22:45. Rollback triggers: >2% error rate OR p95 latency >1.5s for 5m. Will post status pings during rollout.

cara-sdk: Quick note — we discovered a header casing issue in the wild. Older mobile JS client lowercases headers, so `X-API-VERSION: 2` (caps) gets ignored by some clients. Repro locally: `curl -H 'X-API-VERSION: 2' https://api.redwood.ai/generate` returned v1 for a while.

ben-sre: Good catch. Does gateway have normalization? If not, we'll need tenant pins for affected customers to avoid them flipping to v2 unexpectedly.

luis-sre: I can ship a lightweight header-normalize middleware at 22:30 that lowercases and parses `x-api-version` and numeric values. Plan: deploy to staging now, smoke, then prod canary at 22:45.

alice: Gateway normalization is preferred vs mass tenant pinning. @luis-sre please proceed if you can get tests green. If not, we'll add tenant pins for the top impacted customers.

cara-sdk: I'll also push a tiny patch to the mobile SDK this afternoon to normalize header lookup (fall back to any casing). But many customers don't update fast, so pins still needed for a subset.

evans-pm: I'll update release notes with migration guidance and a snippet showing the header normalization change. Also will notify top-10 tenants via partnership channels.

ben-sre: Ops suggestion: add a short-lived fallback rule in the router — if `x-api-version` missing or unrecognizable, route to v1 and log the event with tenant id. That gives us safer canary behavior and explicit signals.

alice: Agree. Let's keep fallback-on-unknown -> v1 for canary window only. Rollback criteria reiterated: immediate rollback if canary error >2% or sudden spike in 500s from specific tenant(s). Command to rollback: `deploy-bot rollback v2-cutover-/generate --immediate`

deploy-bot: Ack. I'll watch the following metrics during canary: p95 latency, error-rate, and client-compat logs (router fallback counts). Will post an update at 22:50 and 23:05.

luis-sre: Staging smoke done: header-normalize passed, basic canary test OK. Posting logs in #eng-infra. Will promote to prod canary at 22:45.

partner-success: Heads-up from customer ops: tenant-42 asked to be pinned to v1 until their SDK update lands next week. Can we add tenant-42 to pinlist now?

cara-sdk: tenant-42 is one of the ones we expect. I'll mark the SDK release with migration notes and a timeline.

alice: Add tenant-42 to pinlist for the window. Any other tenant pin requests? If so list them now. Otherwise we'll proceed with header normalize + fallback.

ben-sre: I'll be watching for any skew in region eu-west-1; if we see >1% errors there during canary we'll pause.

alice: Great. Thanks everyone — final checklist: (1) luis deploy header-normalize @22:30, (2) deploy-bot canary @22:45, (3) evan publish release notes + migration snippet, (4) pins: tenant-42 added, (5) rollback command ready. Post any last-minute blockers here.

cara-sdk: thumbs up. I'll follow up if any other tenant reports.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 22:45. Status: healthchecks ok (p95 latency 420ms, error-rate 0.1%). Will continue to monitor.

luis-sre: Canary smoke (22:50): header-normalize looks good, router fallback logs minimal. Promoting gradual traffic shift now.

ben-sre: Monitoring — no spike in 500s. eu-west-1 looks stable.

alice: If we stay green for next 10m we'll continue cutover. Posting release-note link in #eng-docs once evan finishes.

evans-pm: Release notes published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2-cutover (includes migration snippet and header snippet).

partner-success: tenant-42 pinned. thanks.

alice: Thanks team. If anything goes sideways: `deploy-bot rollback v2-cutover-/generate --immediate`. Otherwise, I'll send a short rollforward note when complete. :white_check_mark:
